privacy_page.cards.0.copy: We process your username, email address, password hash, verification details and the profile information you provide, such as name, phone number, avatar, occupation, business name, country, city and address. If you choose Google or GitHub sign-in, we receive account identifiers and available profile information from that provider. We use this information to create and secure your account, verify access, maintain your profile and provide account support.
privacy_page.cards.0.title: Account and profile information
privacy_page.cards.1.copy: We process the text, audio, images, documents and voice references you submit, together with task settings, generated audio, text, subtitles and other outputs. Jobs can retain submitted text, input/output metadata, status, errors, timestamps and usage or credit records. These support processing, result access, history and billing accuracy. Our policy is not to use customer uploads or generated outputs to train MetKurd models. This does not establish a data-use commitment for every external provider.
privacy_page.cards.1.title: Submitted content and processing records
privacy_page.cards.10.copy: Deleted information may remain temporarily in backup or disaster-recovery systems until those backups are overwritten or expired under the applicable backup cycle. This policy does not specify a backup duration. Revocation or deletion in MetKurd does not automatically remove downloaded copies, chat-service copies or records held by external providers under their own policies.
privacy_page.cards.10.title: Backups and external copies
privacy_page.cards.11.copy: You can edit supported profile fields, change your password, manage API keys and revoke MCP connections through your account. You can view and download available results and use file-deletion controls where available. Some deletion actions may be restricted or fail; contact support if you cannot remove a file. Revocation is an access control, not an account-deletion action. There is no self-service account-erasure workflow in the current account interface. Contact us to request account deletion, access to information or correction; identity checks and retention obligations may affect what can be removed.
privacy_page.cards.11.title: Your account and file controls
privacy_page.cards.12.copy: Use the Contact page or email support@metkurd.ai for privacy questions, corrections, access or deletion requests, including questions about retention of a particular record. Identify the request without sharing your password, API key or OAuth token. Third-party chat services, sign-in services and other providers may also offer controls for information held in their own systems.
privacy_page.cards.12.title: Privacy questions and requests
privacy_page.cards.2.copy: When you authorize a connection, we store the client identity and name, approved permissions, connection status, creation and last-use times, revocation information and OAuth authorization/token records. We use these to enforce your consent and account access. The connected client sends tool arguments to MetKurd and receives permitted job information and results, including content when requested. The tools do not require your full chat history. Revoking a connection stops further authorized access; it does not erase previous jobs or copies already received by the client.
privacy_page.cards.2.title: Connected accounts and MCP access
privacy_page.cards.3.copy: The website uses session cookies and browser storage for sign-in and preferences such as theme. Public pages load Google Analytics for website usage measurement. Requests and technical records may include IP addresses, browser/device information, routes, timestamps, status and error details. Human verification sends challenge information and the request IP address to Cloudflare Turnstile. These data support website operation, usage measurement, abuse prevention and troubleshooting. Browser controls can limit cookies or scripts, although blocking essential storage can affect sign-in.
privacy_page.cards.3.title: Website, analytics and security data
privacy_page.cards.4.copy: The contact form collects your name, email, subject and message. It sends these to our support channel on Telegram with request IP, browser information and available IP-derived location details, which may include country, region, city, postal code and estimated coordinates. Registration and payment notifications can also send account/contact details, verification or transaction information and request metadata to authorized operational channels. We use these messages to answer requests and manage account and payment operations. Avoid sending passwords, access tokens or unnecessary sensitive content in support messages.
privacy_page.cards.4.title: Support and operational notifications
privacy_page.cards.5.copy: For account billing, we retain credit balances, usage, reservations, ledger entries, orders, payment references, amounts, currencies, statuses and related audit records. Where provided by a payment integration, records can include provider customer/method references and masked card details, brand and expiry. Payment providers such as FIB and Areeba process their part of website payments. The plugin itself does not offer purchases or checkout; it uses existing account permissions and API credits.
privacy_page.cards.5.title: Billing and payment records
privacy_page.cards.6.copy: Authorized personnel and service providers process information to operate the service. Recipient categories include infrastructure hosting, databases, object storage and delivery, compute/inference, email and phone-verification delivery, social authentication, payment processing, security, analytics and support messaging. Processing providers receive the submitted text or access to the media needed for the requested task. Google/GitHub sign-in, Google Analytics, Cloudflare verification, Telegram notifications and payment integrations receive information relevant to their functions. A connected chat service also receives the tool responses you authorize. We do not promise identical retention or data-use terms across these recipients.
privacy_page.cards.6.title: Who receives information
privacy_page.cards.7.copy: Temporary API/MCP processing files have an expiry recorded for the job or file; the service default is seven days after submission. MCP upload-handoff files, including voice references newly uploaded through that handoff, use a temporary expiry measured from upload. Consult the expiry shown for the specific file. Expiry ends access, while physical removal depends on cleanup completing. MCP upload links expire after 15 minutes. Link expiry does not delete durable upload-session metadata, which currently has no automatic pruning policy.
privacy_page.cards.7.title: Temporary files and upload links
privacy_page.cards.8.copy: Normal web/customer results, permanent API files and existing saved voice references follow their own retention state; the seven-day temporary-file rule does not apply to all of them. They may remain until customer or service deletion or another applicable retention state. Deleting a generated result does not automatically delete a separately saved voice reference. File deletion removes the stored object when successful and marks its records as deleted. Job inputs, file metadata, account, usage, financial and audit records can remain; deleting a file is not complete erasure of all associated information.
privacy_page.cards.8.title: Saved files, references and deletion
privacy_page.cards.9.copy: We retain account, job, support, security, billing and audit records for as long as reasonably necessary to provide the service, maintain account and transaction history, protect security, resolve disputes, comply with legal or accounting obligations, and enforce our agreements. Retention periods vary by record type. When information is no longer required for these purposes, it may be deleted or anonymized in accordance with our operational and legal requirements. There is no single fixed deletion period for these records. Financial and audit history is maintained separately from file expiry and deletion.
privacy_page.cards.9.title: Retention of account and service records
privacy_page.lead: This policy explains how MetKurd AI handles information when you use our website, account services, API and connected MCP tools.

research_development_page.lead: Building useful Kurdish AI requires more than connecting a generic model. MetKurd AI was developed through Kurdish-focused data preparation, manual review, language testing, and continuous improvement around Sorani Kurdish speech and text.
research_development_page.meta.descripti: Learn how MetKurd AI approaches Kurdish-first research, data preparation, and quality improvement for Sorani Kurdish AI tools.
research_development_page.meta.keywords: Kurdish AI research, Sorani AI development, MetKurd AI R&D, Kurdish language technology
research_development_page.meta.title: Research and Development | MetKurd AI
research_development_page.sections.0.cop: Kurdish AI data was difficult to collect, so the team recorded and prepared data manually for practical model training and evaluation workflows.
research_development_page.sections.1.cop: Kurdish spelling and word correctness were reviewed with Kurdish language teachers and academic reviewers to improve quality and linguistic consistency.
research_development_page.sections.2.cop: A lack of official and dependable dictionaries created additional validation challenges in normalization, correction, and lexical alignment.
research_development_page.sections.3.cop: Output quality depends heavily on data quality, so data cleaning, annotation discipline, and repeated evaluation remain central to progress.
research_development_page.sections.4.cop: Different approaches and models were tested across speech and text workflows to improve real-world usability for Kurdish users.
research_development_page.title: How MetKurd AI approaches Kurdish AI research and development

public.home_faq.entity.title: What is MetKurd AI?
public.home_faq.kurdish.title: What is Kurdish AI?
public.home_faq.kurdish.copy: Kurdish AI means tools designed to work with Kurdish language content. MetKurd focuses on practical Sorani Kurdish workflows for creators, organizations and education.
public.home_faq.dialects.title: Does MetKurd support Sorani and Kurmanji?
public.home_faq.dialects.copy: The primary focus is Sorani (Central Kurdish) in Arabic script. Kurmanji is not currently supported. Arabic and English support depends on the selected tool.
public.home_faq.tts.title: How can I convert Kurdish text to speech?
public.home_faq.tts.copy: Open a text-to-speech tool, enter your script, select a voice and generate audio. Current products: :products. Listen and review before publishing.
public.home_faq.asr.title: Can AI transcribe Kurdish speech?
public.home_faq.asr.copy: Speech-to-text converts a recording into written text. Current products: :products. Clear Sorani speech gives more useful transcripts; check names and unfamiliar terms.
public.home_faq.caption.title: Can MetKurd create Kurdish subtitles?
public.home_faq.caption.copy: Caption creates transcripts with timestamps and subtitle exports. Review the wording and synchronization before adding subtitles to your video.
public.home_faq.ctts.title: Can I clone a Kurdish voice?
public.home_faq.ctts.copy: Use a clear reference recording with permission from its speaker, then enter your text. Current products: :products. Do not use voice cloning to impersonate or mislead.
public.home_faq.ocr.title: Can AI read Sorani Kurdish images and PDFs?
public.home_faq.ocr.copy: OCR extracts text from images and scanned documents. Clean, well-lit pages improve recognition. Review spelling and layout before reusing text in books, archives or research.
public.home_faq.harakat.title: What does Harakat do?
public.home_faq.harakat.copy: Arabic diacritization: add vowel marks to Arabic text and review or download the result. Harakat is a text service, not OCR or Kurdish diacritization.
public.home_faq.stem.title: Can MetKurd separate vocals from music?
public.home_faq.stem.copy: Yes. Current separation products: :products. Choose the available track layout for your task. This operation works independently of language; results can contain separation artifacts.
public.home_faq.audience.title: Can businesses and universities use MetKurd?
public.home_faq.audience.copy: Yes. Media teams, universities, NGOs and businesses can use the available tools for Kurdish content, accessibility, document digitization and research workflows. Choose a plan that fits your usage and review outputs.
public.home_faq.accuracy.title: What if an AI result contains mistakes?
public.home_faq.accuracy.copy: Review every result before publishing or relying on it. Clear recordings, readable scans and carefully written input help, but AI can still make mistakes.
public.home_faq.privacy.title: Are uploads used for AI training?
public.home_faq.privacy.copy: The published MetKurd privacy policy states that customer uploads and generated outputs are not used for AI training. Account files are private; only separately configured public examples appear on this website.
public.home_faq.api.title: Which plans include API access?
public.home_faq.api.copy: MetKurd provides API access on eligible configured paid plans. API requests use separate API credits, tool permissions and processing limits. Check the developer portal for your current access.
public.home_faq.mcp.title: Can ChatGPT, Claude, Codex and other AI assistants use MetKurd?
public.home_faq.mcp.copy: Yes. MetKurd MCP uses the Model Context Protocol to let compatible AI assistants access specialized Kurdish AI tools, including Kurdish text to speech, voice cloning, Kurdish speech to text, captions, Kurdish OCR and audio separation. Access requires an active eligible non-Free MetKurd plan, the required tool permissions and sufficient API credits for paid processing. MCP must be enabled on MetKurd, and the AI client must support remote authenticated MCP servers. Support varies by client, plan and configuration; not every ChatGPT, Claude or Codex setup supports it.

public.pricing_faq.app.title: What are App credits?
public.pricing_faq.app.copy: App credits pay for processing inside the MetKurd application. Each tool charges by its billing unit, such as characters, minutes or pages; check the estimate before submitting.
public.pricing_faq.wallets.title: What are API credits?
public.pricing_faq.wallets.copy: API credits are a separate balance for authorized developer requests. App credits do not grant API access or replace API credits.
public.pricing_faq.free.title: Does Free include API or MCP?
public.pricing_faq.free.copy: No. Free is for using eligible tools in the application. Developer access requires an eligible non-Free plan and the relevant permissions; retained credits alone do not grant access.
public.pricing_faq.empty.title: What happens when credits run out?
public.pricing_faq.empty.copy: New processing requires enough credits in the correct wallet. You can still access your account and retained results. Review available top-ups or plan options before starting more work.
public.pricing_faq.storage.title: How does storage work?
public.pricing_faq.storage.copy: Uploaded and generated files count toward your storage quota. Retention depends on the workflow. Manage files in your account and check available storage before submitting large jobs.
public.pricing_faq.changes.title: Can I upgrade or cancel?
public.pricing_faq.changes.copy: Use the billing area to review available upgrades and recurring renewal controls. Cancelling renewal and the end of your current access are separate; review the dates shown in your account.
public.pricing_faq.limits.title: Are processing limits different by tool?
public.pricing_faq.limits.copy: Yes. Text length, file size, duration, supported formats and simultaneous jobs depend on the tool and your plan. The application validates inputs before processing. Credits are not a fixed number of audio seconds.

Background noise and overlapping speakers can affect recognition; check names, wording and subtitle timing before publishing.
public.terminology.note: MetKurd keeps AI as its main term; Super Intelligence (SI) is an alternate label used in the U.S. executive branch, not a claim about our capabilities.
public.home_faq.terminology.title: What does Super Intelligence (SI) mean here?
public.home_faq.terminology.copy: The September 29, 2026 U.S. executive order uses Super Intelligence (SI) for AI in non-statutory executive-branch communications. MetKurd retains AI as its primary term. This terminology does not mean MetKurd has artificial general intelligence (AGI) or superhuman capabilities; its specialized language and audio tools still need human review.
public.github.heading: Official developer resources
public.github.copy: MetKurd AI maintains an official public GitHub organization for developer resources. The public metkurd-api repository contains the official REST API V2 documentation, OpenAPI 3.1 specification, Postman collection and example clients for cURL, Python, PHP, Node.js and JavaScript. The hosted MetKurd platform, models and internal application source remain proprietary.
public.home_faq.github.title: Does MetKurd AI have an official GitHub repository?
public.home_faq.github.copy: Yes. MetKurd AI maintains the official GitHub organization MetKurdAI. The public metkurd-api repository contains REST API V2 documentation, an OpenAPI 3.1 specification, a Postman collection and example clients. The hosted MetKurd platform, models and internal application source are not published as open-source software.
